End a loop iteration.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Marks the end of a loop. Collects results and determines whether to continue iterating.

| --- | --- |
| Category | [Workflow](../categories/workflow.md) |
